subject: Suncrest vendor enrollment: banking evidence and remittance formatting
messages:
From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@suncrest.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@suncrest.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Suncrest banking proof + remittance string

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To complete our vendor enrollment we attached the bank certification and W-9. A couple of asks to close out on our side: 

- Can you confirm the remittance string we should use on the PO/invoice so our ERP maps payments correctly?
- Let us know whether you prefer ACH (ACH CCD) or a wire for the initial setup remittance test.
- If you need additional bank contact info or a bank letter on letterhead we can provide that via DocuSign.

Attachments: Suncrest_Bank_Certification.pdf, Suncrest_W9.pdf

Emily Cho
Senior Finance Manager
Suncrest LLC
emily.cho@suncrest.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@suncrest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Suncrest banking proof + remittance string

Emily — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. I reviewed the bank certification and W-9; they look complete. A few quick items before payments can schedule the test remittance: 

1) Please confirm the exact remittance string you want on Redwood POs/invoices (example: "PO# {{po_number}} - Suncrest LLC - INV{{invoice_number}}"). If you have a specific ERP tag we should include, paste the exact text.
2) Payments team prefers ACH for recurring payouts, but for the first validation we typically do a $0.01 micro-deposit (ACH CCD) to verify the account. If you require a wire instead for regulatory reasons, let us know.
3) If DocuSign is required for the bank letter, we'll accept the signed PDF link.

I'll loop in David from Payments to schedule the micro-deposit. Once that's verified we'll mark the vendor active and share the remittance mapping confirmation.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Thanks, Mina. Emily — copying Ben from Payments Ops for ledger mapping questions. We can run an ACH micro-deposit today at ~4:00pm PT or schedule a wire tomorrow morning; preference?

What we need from you (quick checklist):
- Confirm remittance string exactly as you want it on the PO/invoice. Example we use internally: "Suncrest LLC | PO# {po} | INV{invoice}" (if you want ERP tags included specify them).
- Confirm account holder name matches the W-9 exactly (it does in the documents you sent).

Plan:
- If ACH micro-deposit is OK, we'll send a $0.01 test deposit (ACH CCD) and provide a verification ID. Once you confirm receipt we’ll flip the vendor to active and push the remittance mapping to the finance system.
- If you need a wire for initial verification, we'll run a $1.00 wire but that will require bank SWIFT/IBAN details and may take longer.

Please reply with preferred channel and the final remittance string.

--
David Kim
Payments Manager | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com

Hi David / Mina — thanks. ACH micro-deposit is fine. Please use the remittance string exactly as below: 

Suncrest LLC | PO# {{po_number}} | Invoice {{invoice_number}} | ERP: SUN-AR

We received the $0.01 deposit at 13:02 PT today (reference: Redwood Test 8921). Confirmed. 

Once you flip the vendor to active, can you also confirm the remittance CSV field mapping (we use: po_number, invoice_number, remit_amount, remit_date, customer_ref)? If you can attach a quick CSV header sample that'd be super helpful for our AR team.

Thanks again — looking forward to going live next billing cycle.

Emily Cho
